description: This is a shell script file containing tests for Git submodule status, including setup procedures, various status checks, diff comparisons, and conflict resolution scenarios. The script utilizes Git commands, test library functions, and utility functions for output sanitization, primarily for testing Git submodule behaviors.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository with a specified name

methods.name: test_create_repo_with_commit
methods.description: Creates a repository with an initial commit containing files

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file or output is empty

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timestamp or state

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global Git configuration for testing
